benefits_summary: Bank loans between ₹10,00,000 and ₹1,00,00,000 to SC/ST or women entrepreneurs for setting up a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, or trading.
exclusions: Male applicants belonging to General or OBC categories
documents_required: Project Report and Business Incorporation Proof
application_steps: Apply online through standupmitra.in or visit a scheduled commercial bank branch.
Connect with a Stand-Up India Lead District Manager for handholding support.
Submit project report for Composite Loan sanction.
